title: RepoMesh Room Observation v1
description: One observable fact the Bridge projects into a Matrix room. Matrix message text is a display projection of this document; structured truth stays in RepoMesh. Reasoning/THINKING content, system prompts, credentials, raw protocol frames, and unsanitized stdout/stderr are never valid observation content.

body.description: Short sanitized human-readable summary. Never a raw transcript.

taskId.description: Present only for governed execution. Absent/null for plain conversation observations.

toolName.description: Only meaningful with kind=tool_action. The tool name, never its raw arguments.

changedFiles.description: Repository-relative paths. Only meaningful with kind=files_changed or terminal kinds.

questionId.description: Only meaningful with kind=question. References the RepoMesh input_required control request an authorized sender may answer.
